$comment: UI fixtures `just ui-shots` records with `beryl_cli record-fixture` into ui/public/fixtures before capturing: a seeded game between named agents (`wu-control`, the mirror, or `fuzz:<seed>` decks), or a `board` (rust/crates/beryl_cli/src/boards.rs: a scenario setup whose actions play both seats, so that its game never depends on an agent or a deck), stopped at the human seat's first decision of a kind (`first <kind> decision for seat <n>`, kinds as ui/src/generated/protocol.ts names them, optionally `from turn <t>`) or at `game over`, where every condition in `where` also holds of the view (`step <step>`, `attacking`, `blocking`, `targeted trigger on the stack`, `targeted spell on the stack`: one targeting a permanent, `player targeted on the stack`, `ability targeting beside its source`: an ability of a permanent targeting another its controller controls, `opponent's spell on the stack`, `castable <card>`, `playable <card>`: the human may play it as a land, `abilities of <card>`: they may activate more than one of its abilities, `namesake candidates`: the decision offers two objects of one name, `resolving <card>`: the decision is asked by that card's spell or ability as it resolves, `casting <card>`: by that spell as it is cast, `playable pair in hand`: a card the human may play has a twin in their hand, `exiled beneath a permanent`: a card lies in exile until the permanent that exiled it leaves, `attached across the table`: an Aura or Equipment one player controls is attached to a permanent the other controls, `castable from exile`, `known card in the opponent's hand`, `token twins`: two tokens one player controls alike in all the table shows, `changed token`: a token differing from another of its name by its types or an attachment, `stolen permanent`: one its owner doesn't control, `mana floating`: the human has unspent mana, `X on the stack`: a spell or ability on the stack was announced with X above 0, `<mark> beside a twin`: a permanent with `+1/+1 counters`, `damage`, `summoning sickness` or `story or time counters` and no other mark, and another of the same name with none), recording `after` more views past it if given. Shots replay one with `?fixture=<name>`, from its nth view with `&at=<n>`.
